remarks: Silvermine Gem! The heart of the home is an exquisite, high quality custom kitchen that opens to the cozy family room with wood burning fireplace. The kitchen features high end appliances and lots of cabinet storage. The dining room includes a convenient built in hutch and the den/office offers a slider to the deck. Many of the shades are remote control operated for added convenience.  The primary bedroom has numerous closets and built-ins including a vanity and dressing room. The bright, finished basement offers additional, versatile space to suit your needs including a section with rubber flooring for a home gym option. Outside the large deck, overlooking the back yard is ideal for outdoor dining and relaxation. This is such a warm and inviting home, in impeccable condition. Convenient to Silvermine amenities such as the elementary school and park, Silvermine Art Guild, The Mercantile and Tavern at Gray Barns. This is a very special place to live.
